name: EXP-561
summary: EXP-561 is an investigational drug that acts as an inhibitor of the reuptake of serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine. It was developed in the 1960s by Du Pont and was suggested as a potential antidepressant but failed in trials and was never marketed.

summaryZh: EXP-561，即4-苯基雙環[2.2.2]辛-1-胺，是一種有機化合物，化學式為C14H19N。它可以被3-氯過氧苯甲酸氧化為1-硝基-4-苯基雙環[2.2.2]辛烷。在碳酸鉀的存在下，它可以和1-溴-2-甲氧基乙烷在乙腈中加熱反應，得到N-(2-甲氧基乙基)-4-苯基雙環[2.2.2]辛-1-胺。
